jobs.description: IntroductionINM is an internationally leading centre for interdisciplinary research on (bio)hybrid materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological processes, physical analysis, and process engineering. We aim for leadership in the fields of opto-interactive, electro-integrative and bio-intelligent material systems. In these areas, we actively seize opportunities to transfer our scientific results into materials-driven innovation.The INM research group, Bioprogrammable Materials, is looking for an enthusiastic Post-Doctoral Researcher with experience in microbial biotechnology and adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE). We are seeking to fill a 2-year funded Post-Doctoral Researcher position as part of an Industrially-aligned European project developing sustainable biobased coatings. The candidate will be part of an international, multi-disciplinary team in which English is the primary language of communication and reporting. In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for severalPostdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.Scope: full-timeDuration: fixed-term, 2 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2026-11-09Your tasks:- Our goal is to attract postdoctoral researchers and enable them to conducttheir research with the mentorship of a PI. We expect that within the durationof this contract, candidates will be able to achieve independent achievementsin research, e.g through publications or joint research endeavours.- Therefore, we are permanently looking for excellent candidateswithoutstanding doctoral degrees in computer science, electrical engineering,mathematics and psychology (preferably with a relationship to technology) orrelated disciplines.Your profile:- An above-average doctoral degree in computer science, electricalengineering, mathematics, psychology (preferably with a relationship totechnology) or related disciplines is mandatory for the application.- Fluent spoken and written English is also required.- In addition, applicants should have basic knowledge of one or more of theresearch areas relevant to CASA: Cryptography, system security, hardwaresecurity, decentralized security, human-centered security, Al and security.- Postdoctoral students should already have published relevant papers attheleading conferences in cryptography and computer security research, aslisted e.g. at http://csrankings.org/.https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/67220716e3f3ba2e0f3fbc621a18dc39d659de040?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/67220716e3f3ba2e0f3fbc621a18dc39d659de040?ref=AfA)

The Max Planck Society is one of the leading research organizations in Europe. We offer challenging tasks with a high degree of personal responsibility and creative freedom in research laboratories, workshops, libraries and administration.The Max Planck Society strives to increase employment of severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled people are expressly encouraged.Furthermore, the Max Planck Society wants to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore expressly encouraged to apply.The Little Pumpkins Parents' Association offers childcare for children under the age of 3 at the MPIPZ.It is possible to apply for a low-cost Germany job ticket with a subsidy from the Institute. The institute also has a rental bike station run by the provider nextbike, as well as the possibility of using rental scooters from various providers.The Department of Comparative Development and Genetics at the Max Planck Institute for Plant Breeding Research (MPIPZ) in Cologne is seeking to fill2 x Research Support positions (m/f/d) to contribute to our daily laboratory work on mechanisms underlying plant development and diversity. The successful applicants will work in close collaboration with experienced research technicians and scientists at different levels and they will cultivate and characterize developmental traits in plant strains derived from mutagenesis and wild collections as well as transgenic plants. They will also be involved in generation of new transgenic plants. Experience in molecular biology (genomic DNA extraction, PCR, cloning), and in handling and cultivating plants, as well as experience with plant genetics is essential (further information on our research: https://www.mpipz.mpg.de/tsiantis). Experience working with Arabidopsis, including the generation of transgenic plants and CRISPR/Cas mutants, is a strong asset. Experience with single cell approaches is also of interest. Additional tasks will involve maintaining lab genetic collections, preparing culture media and assisting in organizing and daily running of an S1 lab. The level of independent work and responsibility will depend on qualifications.Successful candidates will have completed professional training as either a research technician with first professional experience, or as a biology graduate (B.Sc. in plant genetics or an equivalent discipline) with work experience or an additional educational qualification. We are searching for highly motivated candidates with an organized working style and highly developed teamwork skills. Applicants should be enthusiastic about scientific research in an international environment. Excellent documentation skills, computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Electronic lab book applications) as well as fluent English are required.We offer stimulating and multi-faceted positions (full-time employment) in a friendly and international environment. Payment and benefits are according to the German TVöD and will depend on experience, knowledge and qualifications. The positions are for one year, starting as early as possible and no later than February 2027, with the possibility of renewal.

jobs.description: Shape compliance. Drive governance. Protect global business. At DHL Group, we connect people and improve lives through our global logistics network. We are looking for an experienced Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our insurance activities remain compliant, transparent, and future-ready. This position combines insurance taxation, regulatory compliance, governance, and stakeholder management in a highly international environment. Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d)   Why experienced insurance professionals join this role* Move from advising to owning insurance governance decisions.* Shape multinational insurance programs across a global organization.* Influence strategic decisions involving Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, and Risk Management.* Work at the intersection of insurance, regulation, governance, and business strategy.* Gain exposure to some of the most complex international insurance arrangements in the market. You'll make an impact by:* Defining and evolving DHL Group's global insurance governance framework.* Ensuring regulatory excellence across international insurance programs.* Leading complex tax, regulatory, and compliance initiatives.* Managing interactions with authorities, regulators, auditors, brokers, and insurers.* Providing strategic guidance on multinational insurance structures and cross-border risk solutions. What You Will Do:Insurance Tax & Compliance* Serve as the central expert for insurance premium tax matters in Germany.* Advise business stakeholders on insurance taxation, insurance distribution compliance, and regulatory requirements.* Assess domestic and international insurance programs, including multinational insurance structures, global master policies, local policies, captive insurance arrangements, and Freedom of Services (FOS) solutions.* Review and evaluate insurance premium tax treatment for insurance contracts and insurance-related services.* Support the design, implementation, and launch of new insurance programs while ensuring tax and regulatory compliance. Governance & Risk Management* Maintain and continuously improve insurance tax governance and compliance frameworks.* Design and oversee internal control systems for insurance premium tax processes.* Contribute to the enhancement of DHL Group's Tax Compliance Management System.* Conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews related to insurance distribution and taxation.* Promote transparency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across the organization.  Regulatory & Audit Management* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany. Cross-Functional Collaboration* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. What You Bring* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency. Who You AreYou are a strategic and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex regulatory environments. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality. What We Offer* A highly visible role with global impact across one of the world's leading logistics companies.* Exposure to complex international insurance, tax, and compliance topics.* Opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.* A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.* Continuous professional development and career growth opportunities within DHL Group.(Employer value proposition formulated based on the role's global scope and responsibilities.) Why DHL Group?At DHL Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow. We value diverse perspectives and believe that our people are the key to our success. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and performance. Your benefits * Well-Being: Fun, team spirit, and health are crucial factors. Therefore, within the company, we offer a wide range of health and preventive care services, an occupational physician* Family-friendly: The compatibility of family and work has many facets, such as childcare, care for family members, etc. We support this, for example, through kindergarten places as well as the Betreuungs- und Erholungswerk (support and recreation program).* Employee Share Program: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in DHL Group's employee share program and share directly in the company's long-term success.* Mobility: We move not only letters or parcels but also our employees through offerings such as company bicycles, job tickets and possibly company cars.* Location: The Post Campus brings together people from more than 60 countries. The Post Tower is easily accessible by car, public transportation and bicycle. To facilitate the workday, the campus offers amenities such as parking spaces, post office, café, canteen and more.* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program, etc., lay the foundation for a successful start at DHL Group.* Development opportunities: We offer numerous development opportunities through a comprehensive training landscape, junior talent programs, coaching etc.* Social commitment: Through global corporate programs, we improve the educational and career opportunities for young people and engage in disaster management at airports. We also contribute to local environmental protection and aid projects initiated by employees on a voluntary basis.* What else? Company pension plan, social counseling, inclusion consulting, cleaning service, insurance cooperation, corporate discounts, events, sabbaticals and much more!
